pages.title: A busy office · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine in the morning in a busy office in Boston. Eva sits at her desk with a cup of coffee. She works all day and studies at night. Her coworker Dan is in the next room. Today she needs to leave a little early. She walks to his door with a small smile.
“Good morning, Dan! Do you have a minute?” says Eva. “Sure. What do you need?” says Dan. “I study English at night, so I leave at five.” says Eva.
